name: goturtle
description: GoTurtle — last-mile logistics ERP for Egypt (Ops, Brand, Hero and Client portals) in one Node.js app

scripts.build: npm run build -w @goturtle/shared && npm run build -w @goturtle/web && npm run build -w @goturtle/api
scripts.dev: npm run build -w @goturtle/shared && concurrently -n api,web -c green,cyan "npm run dev -w @goturtle/api" "npm run dev -w @goturtle/web"
scripts.typecheck: npm run build -w @goturtle/shared && npm run typecheck -w @goturtle/api && npm run typecheck -w @goturtle/web
scripts.test: npm run build -w @goturtle/shared && npm test -w @goturtle/shared && npm test -w @goturtle/api
